summary.goal: Create IdeationIntegration class (like ForgeIntegration/PlannerIntegration) and extend TunerClient for ideation consumers

acceptance_criteria.description: IdeationIntegration class with: initialize(), getConfig(), isAvailable(), recordIdeationOutcome(), refreshConfig(), shutdown()
getConfig() returns DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG when Tuner unavailable
recordIdeationOutcome() is fire-and-forget (logs warning on failure, never throws)
Auto-refresh config every 5 minutes (matching Forge/Planner pattern)
TunerClient extended with: getIdeationConfig(), submitIdeationOutcome(), submitPlanQualitySignal()
Exported from tuner package for ideation to import

steps.title: Extend TunerClient with ideation methods
steps.description: Add getIdeationConfig(), submitIdeationOutcome(), submitPlanQualitySignal() to packages/tuner/src/client/tuner-client.ts

acceptance_criteria.description: async getIdeationConfig(): Promise<IdeationConfig> calls GET /api/tuner/config/ideation
async submitIdeationOutcome(outcome): Promise<OutcomeResponse> POSTs to /outcomes/ideation
async submitPlanQualitySignal(signal): Promise<OutcomeResponse> POSTs to /outcomes/plan-quality
Uses this.get() / this.post() with AbortController timeout
constructor(options?: { tunerUrl?: string; refreshIntervalMs?: number })
async initialize() fetches config, sets available=true on success
getConfig() returns this.config ?? DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG
isAvailable() returns this.available
async recordIdeationOutcome(outcome) is fire-and-forget (try/catch, log warning, never throw)
async refreshConfig() fetches and updates this.config
shutdown() clears this.refreshInterval

steps.title: Start refresh interval on initialize
steps.description: In IdeationIntegration.initialize(), start setInterval to call refreshConfig() every 5 minutes (default)

acceptance_criteria.description: Default refreshIntervalMs = 5 * 60 * 1000
this.refreshInterval = setInterval(() => this.refreshConfig(), ...)
Errors in refreshConfig logged but don't kill interval

steps.title: Export IdeationIntegration from tuner package
steps.description: Add export to packages/tuner/src/index.ts for IdeationIntegration and related types

acceptance_criteria.description: export { IdeationIntegration } from './integrations/ideation-integration';
export { IdeationConfig, IdeationOutcome, PlanQualitySignal, DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG } from './domain/...';
Ideation package can import via: import { IdeationIntegration } from '@planner/tuner';

steps.title: Test IdeationIntegration
steps.description: Unit tests for IdeationIntegration covering graceful fallback, fire-and-forget, auto-refresh

acceptance_criteria.description: initialize() succeeds when Tuner reachable, sets available=true
initialize() fails gracefully when Tuner unreachable, available=false, getConfig returns defaults
recordIdeationOutcome() logs warning on network failure but doesn't throw
Auto-refresh updates config periodically
shutdown() clears interval
